item.title: Episode 14: Behind the Mic — Part 2: We Got a Listener (And Regret Nothing)
item.description: The unfiltered ask from Episode 13 worked. The show has a real 21st listener (someone's grandmother, who calls Alex "the hallway man") and its first donation: $3.50, demanding Alex buy an actual chair. A very funny replay of the "meeting to schedule a meeting" bit follows, complete with a judgmental cat casting the deciding vote.
